svg.title: Dispersal rig (3D prop reference)
svg.desc: A compact wheeled aerosol dispersal rig in worn matte steel, seen three-quarter from slightly above on plain white: a low riveted cabinet on four solid casters with a push bar, two strapped pressure tanks with domed heads, gauges and hand valves, hoses looping from the valves to an upright mast, a jointed nozzle arm reaching forward to a flared nozzle crusted with rust and ochre residue, a small dark CRT screen set in a steel housing with two knobs, and a riveted plate stamped RCC on the cabinet's front. One object, whole, no figure, no other thing.
